# A bill paid on the company card, entered from the block rather than linked.
#
# No `txn_guid:`, so the run writes the settlement itself against
# `Liabilities:Credit Card USD`. This is the other way a liability reaches a
# bill payment: the widening that lets a card be named applies here too, and
# the sign of a split the run creates is not the sign of one it moves.
#
# What this fixture produces: the payable settled, and
# `Liabilities:Credit Card USD` at −100.00 — what the company now owes the
# card issuer.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
2026-01-01 open Expenses:Supplies:USD
  type: Expense
  commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
  commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Liabilities:Credit Card USD
  type: Credit Card
  commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
  commodity.mnemonic: "USD"

bill "BILL-CARD-002"
  vendor_id: "V-US"
  currency: USD
  date_opened: 2026-02-01
  entry:
    date: 2026-02-01
    description: "Supplies"
    account: "Expenses:Supplies:USD"
    quantity: 1
    price: 100
    taxable: false
  posted:
    date: 2026-02-01
    due: 2026-03-01
    ap_account: "Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD"
    memo: "Bill BILL-CARD-002"
    accumulate: true
  payment:
    date: 2026-02-20
    amount: 100
    account: "Liabilities:Credit Card USD"
    memo: "Paid on the company card"
